Commentary.Commentary: England have one over to face and Sri Lanka would love a wicket here today. Six balls is all the openers have to tackle but let me tell you, it is going to be a very nervy period. Can Sri Lanka pick atleast one or will England enter Day 3 unscathed? Join us to fine out.

What a comeback by Sri Lanka, they have not only wiped the deficit out but have also taken a lead of 46. Who would have thought they would head into the third innings with the advantage, especially when Mathews was dismissed and the Lankans were reeling at 165-6. England looked all set to take a big lead but the Lankan lower-order gave them a taste of thier own medicine. Roshen Silva was the mainstay and the rest played around him. The lower-order added 171 runs between them and now Sri Lanka are in the driver's seat.

He misses and the ball hits him on the pads. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. England think about a review and opt against it. Rightly so as Hawk Eye shows it to be missing the stumps.
Uses his feet and tries to force it through the off side but gets it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Tosses it up on off, Silva is solid in defense.
Silva paddles it fine through fine leg. The batsmen take three runs.
Good delivery again. Flighted delivery on off, Silva prods forward to defends but misses the outside edge. Lucky escape for Roshen.
CLOSE SHAVE! Well tossed up delivery on middle, Silva leans forward and tries to poke at it but missed the outside edge of the bat. Top delivery that from Leach.
Identical delivery, AM tucks it to leg side. The batsmen rotate strike.
Fuller on middle, Silva tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Mathews drives it mid off for a run.
Flighted delivery on middle, Silva prods forward and tries to defend to but misses the outside edge of the bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller on middle, the batsman pushes it to the point fielder.
Loopy delivery but way outside off. He goes for the cut but misses it.
Fuller on middle, Angelo strokes it to long off for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Mathews defends it with a straight bat.
On the shorter side, Mathews goes back and pushes it through covers for a run.
Tosses it up on middle, Mathews prods forward and defends it.
Flatter and on middle, Mathews goes back and punches it to covers.
A little too close to play the cut shot. Mathews ends up chopping it to the cover fielder.
Tosses it up on off, Mathews lunges and defends it by taking off his bottom hand.
Gives it air on off, Mathews keeps it out.
Fuller on middle, Roshen pushes it gently through point.
Short delivery outside off, AM cuts it through point for a run.
Floats it up on middle, Mathews leans forward and tries to defend it but misses the outside edge of the bat. Rashid needs to be consistent with this line and length.
Fuller on middle, the batsman has pushed it through point for a single. Silva is off the mark with that.
A tad short from the bowler, Roshen rocks back and punches it off the back foot but straight to the cover fielder.
Short from Rashid on middle, Angelo punches it off the back foot through point for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short around off, AM punches it off the back foot through covers for a run.
Flighted delivery on middle, Mathews tries to work it to leg side but gets the thick leading edge and the ball goes towards off side.
Drags his length short, Angelo goes back and punches it off the back foot.
FOUR! SHOT! It was nicely tossed up on middle, Mathews gets to the pitch of the ball and lobs it uppishly over extra cover for a boundary.
Little bit quicker on middle, Mathews defends it by presenting the full face of the bat.
Very slow and very short. Silva goes for the cut but gets it off the toe end towards covers.
Flatter and on off, kept out off the back foot.
Tosses it up a little and bowls it on middle, it is defended.
This is flatter and around off, Silva gets behind the line and keeps it out.
Roshen Silva comes to bat.

OUT! GONE! Rashid strikes! Lovely, lovely bowling this is. Once again he tosses it above the eye and this time lands it around the off pole. It pitches and spins away. Dhananjaya has to play at it and hence is forward to defend it. The ball just about kisses the outside edge and goes into the mitts off the keeper. Foakes takes it and appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Big blow for Sri Lanka as Dhananjaya was set. Half the side back in the hut for Sri Lanka.
BEAUTY! This is nicely tossed up and it is also much slower. Pitches around leg and then turns square, beating the outside edge of Dhananjaya's bat. Just unplayable.
On middle, AM watchfully blocks it out.
Drags it short on this occasion, the batsman hangs back and punches it through point for a run.
Quicker and fuller on middle, de Silva drives it straight to mid on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated delivery on middle, de Silva defends it by presenting the full face of the bat.
Bowls it fuller on middle, the batsman drives it straight to mid off.
Jack Leach to bowl from the other end.
Full on middle, Mathews drives it to the point.
Flatter and quicker on middle, de Silva cuts it through point for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Mathew tries to cut it again but misses the outside edge of the bat.
A tad short outside off, the batsman pushes it through point for a single.
Short again outside off, Angelo again cuts it through point for a brace.
Starts off with a short and wide delivery outside off, Mathews cuts it back towards point for a couple of runs.
We are back for the afternoon session. Angelo Mathews and Dhananjaya de Silva will resume their innings. Adil Rashid will start the proceedings. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

The hosts still trail by another 146 runs, they have a set batsman out there and one who showed good form in the first Test match. They would hope the two can bat long and take them close to the deficit. England on the other hand, will want to take a few wickets quickly and get into the lower order of this Lankan line-up.

Just as everything was going Sri Lanka's way, a moment of brilliant from Ben Stokes found Karunaratne short of his crease. A few overs later, Stokes was once again into the act as he pulled of an excellent catch to get rid of Mendis. Mathews and Dhananjaya, who also passed his fifty, then survived the last few minutes and ensured there were no more wickets to fall before the break.

An excellent session of cricket and you have to award it to the English side due to the two quick wickets in the end. They started off well by picking the nightwatchman early but it was all Sri Lanka after that. Karunaratne and Dhananjaya looked at ease and the two stitched a 96-run stand. The former got to his half ton and looked set for a biggie.
A shorter delivery to end the session and it has been pushed back to the bowler. LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Slows it up this time and pitches it around middle, Dhananjaya blocks it.
Darts it on off, de Silva blocks it out.
Fires it on the pads, Mathews works it around the corner for a run.
Flatter and on off, it is kept out.
Gives it air on off, Mathews strokes it to mid off.
Another loopy delivery on middle, the batsman tries to defend and the ball turns away from him. Beats the outside edge of the bat. Brilliant over from Rashid.
Floats it up on middle, de Silva tries to defend it from the crease but the ball spins away beating the outside edge of the bat.
A tad fuller on this occasion. Angelo pushes it through covers. The batsmen sneak a single.
Short of a length outside off, Mathews cuts it through the off side.
Bowls it slower on off, the batsman punches it through point for a run.
Quicker and fuller on middle, de Silva rocks back and taps it down the off side.
Adil Rashid is back on.
Not a good ball to end, especially after another slip was brought in. This is on the pads, it is worked to short fine leg.
Another edge induced but it is just short. Flatter and on off, the ball pitches and turns away. Takes the outside edge and goes on the bounce to Stokes who makes a half-stop. No runs conceded though.
Tosses it above the eye line outside off, Mathews strokes it to covers.
Tosses it up very full on middle, AM drives it to mid off.
Angles it into the batsman, Mathews keeps it out.
Angelo Matthews walks out to the middle.

OUT! EDGED AND WHAT A CATCH! It is that man Stokes again! You just can't keep him out of the game at the moment. Mendis walks back without troubling the scorers and all of a sudden, Lanka are in a spot of bother here. Leach gets his second. A tossed up delivery on off, it pitches and turns away. Mendis plays inside the line, the ball takes the outside edge, goes just past the keeper's gloves but Stokes at first slip, sticks his left hand out and the ball stays in. Excellent reaction catch and England are pumped up. There are still a few more minutes to go for Lunch, can they take another?
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for de Silva. It was again dragged in short and the batsman pulls it through mid on for a boundary. 9 came from the over of Stokes.
Back of a length on middle, the batsman defends it from within the crease.
Fuller length on middle, de Silva pushes it through point region.

FOUR! De Silva Brings up his 4th Test Fifty. It was dragged in short, he went for the pull and times it nicely through mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence. He needs to continue for a longer period of time. He has been playing well and looks determined to score a big one now.
Back of a length on middle, Kushal punches it off the back foot through covers. They take a single.
Starts off with a short delivery. Mendis ducks underneath it.
Ben Stokes is into the attack now.
Gives s bit of air on middle, de Silva drives it straight to the mid on fielder.
Fuller length lands it on off, the batsman drives it to mid off.
Little bit quicker on middle, Silvs rocks back and tries to flick it but it hits the thigh pad.
Little bit fuller on middle, de Silva drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

What a delivery to start off with. Things have started to change now.  Slower on middle, it turns away sharply. The batsman was on the back foot and luckily it did not get the outside edge of the bat.
Kusal Mendis is the new man in. Also, Jack Leach is back on.

OUT! Yes, England have got the breakthrough. This was probably the only way this partnership could have been broken. A sorry end to a brilliant 96-run stand. A back of a length ball around off, de Silva guides it towards Stokes at point and sets off for a run. The ball bounces nicely for the fielder, he collects it with one hand and then scores a direct hit at the striker's end. The players appeal, they actually start celebrating as they feel Karunaratne is short. The umpire waits to see if there is an overthrow and then takes it upstairs. Time for the replays and it finds Dimuth short. Outstanding work from Stokes, he just had one stump to aim at and nails it. End of a good innings by Karunaratne. Sri Lanka trail by another 158 runs.
A direct hit and have England got the breakthrough? Karunaratne is the man in question. This looks very close.
Full on middle, the batsman drives it straight to mid off.
FOUR!  A tad fuller swings away. de Silva leans forward and pokes at it and gets a thick outside edge and the ball goes between the second slip fielder and races away to the third man fence.
Full on middle, de Silva drives it straight to the covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length on middle, Silva defends it off the back foot and onto the ground.
Tosses it up on middle, the batsman drives it to the point region.
Identical delivery, Karunaratne, pushes it towards mid on fielder.
Quicker on middle, Karunaratne, drives it straight to mid on region.
A tad fuller on middle, the batsman has flicked it through mid- wicket for a run.
Tossed up delivery lands it just outside off. de Silva leans forward and tries to poke at it but missed it completely.
Full on middle, de Silva drives it straight to mid on.
Length delivery outside off. Karunaratne tries to cut it but misses it completely.
A tad fuller on middle, Karunaratne leans forward and defends it by presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length outside off, the batsman lets it be.
A tad full and wide outside off, Karunaratne shoulders arms to it.
FOUR! A full toss and it has been put away! On off and Karunaratne plays it with a straight bat through mid off and the ball races away.
Angles it into the batsman, he works it through square leg for a run.
Fires it on middle, Karunaratne drives it straight to mid off.
Quicker on middle, de Silva has flicked the ball off his pads to the leg side for a run.
A tad fuller on middle, Karunaratne leans forward and drives it towards covers. The fielder misfields it and the batsmen steal a single.
Full on middle, the batsman strokes it to long on for a run.
Flighted delivery on off, de Silva defends it off the front foot and into the ground.
Tosses it up on middle, de Silva sweeps it through fine leg for a couple of runs.
Moeen Ali is back on.
Length delivery outside off, Karunaratne lets it go.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full on his pads, Karunaratne works it to the fine leg region for a couple of runs.
Full around off, Karunaratne leans forward and drives it to the cover region.
Length delivery on middle, Karunaratne blocks it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted on middle, de Silvs comes down the track and blocks it.
The ball is bowled way down leg. Silva goes for a shot but misses it completely.
Floats it up around off, Karunaratne leans forward and pushes it through point for a run.
Quicker on middle, the batsman flicks it through the leg side for a run.
Fuller length on off, de Silva drives it straight to mid on.
Flighted delivery on middle, the batsman has played that off the front foot and onto the ground.
Length delivery on middle, the batsman defends it off the front foot and onto the ground.
Identical delivery, Karunaratne pushes it towards point.
A tad full from Jimmy, Karunaratne drives it straight to mid on.
Good length delivery outside off, Karunaratne shoulders arms to it.
Fuller delivery on off, DK leans forward and drives it firmly past mid on . The batsman get couple of runs.
Fuller length on middle, Karunaratne drives it straight to the mid on.
James Anderson is into the attack.
Full and wide down leg, the batsman pads it out.
Flatter on middle, the batsman flicks it off his pads towards square leg for a run.
Little bit fuller on middle, Karunaratne drives it straight to mid on.
Flighted delivery on middle, the batsman defends it by presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on middle, Karunaratne has pushed it through the point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Gives it a nice loop on off, it is kept out.
The googly but it is on the shorter side, Karunaratne has all the time in the world to go back and guide it through point for a single.
This is eased down to long off for a run.
Gives it air on off, defended.
Floats it up on off, the batsman keeps it out.
Gives it air on off, it pitches and turns away. The batter tries to defend but gets an outside edge down to third man for a single.
On the off stump, defended.
Down the leg side, de Silva fails to flick, the ball brushes the pads and goes towards fine leg. The batsmen run a leg bye.
On the off pole. It is kept out.
Another leg spinner but it is on the shorter side again, Dhananjaya punches it through covers for a couple. 100 up for Sri Lanka, they trail by another 185.
The leg spinner and this turns and he also gets good drift. It drifts into the batsman, then pitches and turns away. It though is slightly short and de Silva easily keeps it out.
On the shorter side outside off, Karunaratne slaps it through covers for a run.
Joe Root brings himself on.

Drinks! Good first hour of play for the Lankans. They lost a wicket early but a partnership of around 50 has steadied the ship a little bit for them. They would for the two to continue and the English side on the other hand, will look to breakthrough this partnership.
Tosses it up on middle, Karunaratne sweeps it through leg side for a run. Brings up his 18th Test Fifty. Good innings so far from the left hander. Sri Lanka needs him to carry on.
FOUR! INNOVATIVE! Flighted on middle, Karunaratne gets into position early and reverse sweeps it through third man for a boundary.
On middle, Karunaratne drives it straight to mid on.
Full on middle, Karunaratne paddles it through leg side straight to the fielder.
Quicker and middle on off, the batsman defends it off the back foot and onto the ground.
Flighted on middle,  Karunaratne tries to reverse sweep it but it gets the top edge of the bat and the ball lobs towards third man. They get a brace.
Flatter and quicker on middle, the batsman punched it off the back foot.
Flatter on middle, the batsman tucks it to the leg side for a couple of runs.
Lovely delivery that. Floats it up on middle, de Silva leans forward and tries to defend it but the ball goes past the outside edge of the bat.
Flighted delivery on middle, de Silva defends it off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on middle, the batsman tucks it to the square leg for a run.
Quicker on middle, Karunaratne taps it to off side.

A huge appeal but not given! Once again it is the slider on middle, de Silva tries to defend with his bat and pad close together. An appeal follows as the English players feel it is pad first. The umpire though shakes his head. That looked close to be honest. Replays however confirms that the on-field call was the right one.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Floats it up on off, Karunaratne drives it to mid off.

How has that missed the off pole? Rashid has got this one absolutely right. The straighter one around off, de Silva does not pick the variation and is beaten inside the line. The ball just about kisses the off pole. Buttler fails to collect it and it goes down towards third man for a bye.
FOUR! Rashid is struggling with his line and length here! Bowls it very short and de Silva has all the time in the world to rock back and pull it through mid on for a boundary.

In the air... but safe! Rashid almost got a wicket of a nothing delivery. Short and down the leg side, Karunaratne tries to flick but gets a leading edge towards deep square leg for a run. 50-run stand up between the two. An important one as the two joined association when Sri Lanka were in trouble. Need to continue though.
Drags his length short, de Silva rocks back and punches it off the back foot to the cover fielder.
Flighted delivery on middle, the batsman flicks it to the mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on middle, Karunaratne tucks it down the leg side.
Tossed it up on middle, DK gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it straight to the mid on fielder.

Rashid is too leg stumpish to the left-hander. Easy pickings for him as he flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Shapes up for the paddle sweep early and Rashid helps him by bowling it down the leg side. Karunaratne plays it towards fine leg for a couple.

Works it around the corner with the turn for a run.
Leading edge! Rashid bowls it on the pads, he begins with a leg spinner. Karunaratne tries to flick but closes the face of the bat a touch early. He gets a soft leading edge to mid off.
Adil Rashid is into the attack.
Fuller on middle, the batsman gets it into position early and reverse sweeps again through short third man and the batsmen get a run.
INNOVATIVE! Flighted delivery on middle, Karunaratne gets into position early and reverse sweeps it to third man for a couple of runs. Adil Rashid there makes a good effort and stops it.
A tad fuller on leg, this occasion,  Karunaratne tries to sweep that but it was hit on the pads.
Flatter and quicker on middle, Silva has punched it off the back foot and the batsmen take a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and onto the ground.
Quicker and flatter on middle, de Silva cuts it towards covers.
On middle, de Silva has driven it through mid on for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and onto the ground.
FOUR! Fuller on middle, Silva gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it straight past the bowler for a boundary.
Quicker and flatter on off, de Silva has punched it off the back foot through covers. The batsmen take two runs.
Floats it up on middle, the batsman defends it off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller length on middle, Karunaratne drives it through mid off for a run
Full on off, driven to covers.
Similar. Pitch is doing a lot. Floats this around off, de Silva has a tentative push at it to get beaten.
Nice. Tossed up outside off, de Silva pokes at it but gets beaten. Pitch is responding.
Gives this air down leg, turned away with the spin to the deep for a brace.
Short again outside off, Dimuth rocks back and pulls it to deep square leg for just one.
Flat and on off, de Silva cuts it through point and gets to the other end.
Floats it up on middle, Karunaratne prods forward and tries to defend it but the ball goes past outside edge of the bat.
Flighted delivery outside off, DK lets it be.
Fullish length on middle, Karunaratne drives it to mid on.
Little bit quicker on middle, the batsman defends it off the front foot and onto the ground.
Full on middle, the batsman drives it through mid on for a run.
FOUR! SHOT! It was tossed up on middle, de Silva leans forward and drives it beautifully through covers and the ball races away to the boundary.
FOUR! DEFT TOUCH! It was bowled little bit quicker on off, the batsman opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for a boundary.
Little bit quicker on middle, de Silva works it to the leg side.
Flighted around off, the ball spins away a bit and the batsman lets it go outside his off stump. Good leave by Silva.
Quicker around off, Silva opens the face of the bat and guides it to short third man.
Tosses it up on middle, the batsman has driven it straight to the mid off fielder.
Fuller and quicker on middle, Silva drives it towards covers.
Flighted on middle,  Karunaratne taps it through the point region.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on middle, DK strokes it to mid on.
Quicker on middle, Karunaratne pushes it towards the point region.
Tossed it up on middle, the batsman has played it through the point region. They run a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Silva tries to drive it but gets gets the inside half of the bat and the ball goes toward the mid-wicket fielder.
Close again! Karunaratne comes down the track and tries to flick. It goes off the inner half and on the bounce to leg slip.
On the pads, it is clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Another loopy ball on middle, Dhananjaya get behind the line and keeps it out.
Gives it air on middle, it is kept out.
SHORT! This is bowled slower and on the stumps, it turns away. Dhananjaya tries to defend it with soft hands but gets an outside edge which falls short of Stokes at first slip.
Walks right across and flicks it through square leg for a run.
Slightly shorter and outside off, it is hit through covers for a run.
Brings the sweep shot out and hits it through square leg for a couple.
Quicker again and outside off, Karunaratne goes for the cut shot but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Flatter and around off, Karunaratne gets behind the line and defends it.
Eases it down to long on with the turn for a run.
Tosses it up nicely on off, it comes back in. Dhananjaya lunges and blocks it out.
Quicker on off, Silva pushes it through point for a run.
Fuller length on middle, DK works it to the on side for a run.
FOUR BYES! Tosses it up on middle, the ball spins away from the bat and the keeper misses it as well and the ball races away to the fine leg boundary.
Identical delivery, Karunaratne works it to the leg side.
On middle, Silva strokes it to long on for a single.
Fuller delivery on middle, the batsman digs it out.
Very full from around the wicket on middle, Karunaratne drives it to mid on.
Floats it up on middle, this is stroked down to long on for a run. Off the mark on the very first ball.
Dhananjaya de Silva is the new man in.

OUT! The nightwatchman departs early this morning. A reckless shot by him. He goes for another slog despite a fielder being placed there. It goes straight to Burns at square leg who takes an easy catch. England strike early, just what they would have wanted.
The last delivery has brought about this shot! Pushpakumara maybe does not trust his defense a lot and hence goes for the slog. Mistimes it to mid on.
Sharp turn! This is tossed up outside off, it spins back in sharply. Malinda tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball lobs up in the air but away from the close-in fielders.
Tosses it up outside off, it is a little full. Malinda strokes it through covers for a brace.
Floats it up on middle, the batsman flicks it to the leg side.
Fuller on middle, DK tucks it through mid-wicket.

NOT OUT! England lose a review. Good bowling through from Leach. Pitches this around off and gets the ball to come back in. Dimuth is forward to play at it but gets beaten for turn and gets wrapped on his back leg. The hosts appeal but the umpire stays put. Root opts for the review. Replays roll in and show us that it would have gone to miss leg.
Action straightaway! A huge shout for an LBW has been turned down. England review it. Looks like it is doing too much.
A tad quicker and fuller on middle, Malinda leans forward and pokes at it. He gets the outside edge of the bat and the ball goes towards short third man. The batsmen sneak a single
Tosses it up on middle, the batsman defends it off the front foot and into the ground.
Little bit quicker on middle, Karunaratne works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Jack Leach to bowl from the other end.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on middle, DK strokes it through wide mid on for a single.
Full on middle, Karunaratne sweeps it through the leg side.
Tossed up outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
Flatter on middle, the batsman was trying to flick it off his pads, but it struck him high on the thigh pad.
Starts of with a flighted delivery on middle, DK leans forward and tries to defend it but it goes past the outside edge of the bat. Already turn taking place from the 1st ball.
We are all set to go! Dimuth Karunaratne and Malinda Pushpakarma will resume their innings. Moeen Ali will start the proceedings for today. Here we go...
Pitch report - Russel Arnold and Brad Hogg say the wicket is quite dry. Reckon the pitch will open up even more and more turn will be evident. Mention Sri Lankans need to bat well.

After some entertaining cricket on Day 1, we welcome you to the coverage of Day 2. Yesterday, we saw runs flowing and wickets tumbling as well. The English side have the upper hand at the moment and they would like to push ahead their advantage. Sri Lanka on other hand, will need partnerships but it is not going to be easy on a wicket which is gripping and turning. The ball is relatively new and one would believe it is now when the batters will face most of the problems. It should get a little easier as the ball gets a little soft but the hosts would hope they have quite a few wickets in hand at that time. The first session is quite important and that should probably show which way the game will be heading.
... Day 2, Session 1 ....

The story of today was quite similar to the one of the first day of the first Test. And on Day 2 we saw the English side blow the hosts away. Will we see the same on Thursday or will Sri Lanka fight back? Judging by how the wicket played right at the end, one would say England will continue their dominance. We will find out at 1000 local (0430 GMT). Do join us.

Earlier in the day, England elected to bat after winning the toss. They were in trouble at 89-4 but Buttler's counter-attacking innings took them to safer shores. Sri Lanka did manage to fight back and they once again had England down and out at 171 for 7 but could not capitalize and the tourists, courtesy Curran's brilliance, got somewhere close to 300.

England's session and you can also say it will be the visitors who will sleep better tonight. After Sam Curran's heroics, the English bowlers had 12 overs to have a go at the Lankan batsman today and they haven't come out empty-handed. They have got the wicket of Silva and it is Leach who has provided the breakthrough by bowling a beauty. However, Pushpakumara and Karunaratne then ensured there were no more wickets to fall and played the day out.
And that has been negotiated, not convincingly though. Floats it on off, this one pitches and turns away. Malinda tries to defend but once again is beaten. THAT IS STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Outside off, left alone. One ball to go.

BEATEN! What a beauty! On middle and turns square. Pushpakumara tries to block it out but is beaten by the away turn. The keeper too fails to collect it but Stokes behind the stumps dives and makes a decent stop. Not cleanly but does not concede any run.

Uppish but safe! Luckily for Malinda that hit Buttler. This was driven uppishly on the off side. Buttler at silly point tries to cling onto it but can't. Had he moved out of the way, that might just have carried to short covers.
BEATEN! Floats it up on off, this pitches and turns away, MP gets beaten.
Uses his feet and it is driven down to long on for a run. Malinda now has to do what he has been sent out to. Play out the 5 balls remaining and protect the batsman.
Flatter and on middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Plays the sweep towards deep square leg but does not take a run. Actually, Karunaratne declines the single. Maybe he does not want to face the offie.
Gives it air and bowls it on a length just behind the last one. Malinda prods forward and tries to defend but the ball turns back in and hits his gloves.
Another tossed up ball outside off, it pitches and comes back in. MP lunges and blocks it.
Flighted ball outside off, it turns back in. Pushpakumara lunges and blocks it out.
Works it against the turn through mid-wicket for a run.
On middle, the batsman defends it from within the crease.
Quicker and fuller on middle, Karunaratne tucks it to the fine leg for a run.
Floats it up on middle, DK defends it by presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on middle, Karunaratne works it to mid-wicket.
Flighted on middle, the batsman plays a sweep shot towards fine leg for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Quicker on leg, the batsman rocks back as he was struck on the pads. But looks like it was going down leg.
On middle,  the batsman watchfully defends it.
Tosess it up on middle, the batsman leans forward and defends it but the ball goes towards short third man.
Flighted on middle, Karunaratne defends it with a striaght bat.
Full on middle, DK  blocks it out.
Floats it up on middle, Pushpakumara strokes it back to the bowler.
Another beauty! Once again gets it to drift into the batsman and the gets it to turn away. Pushpakumara tries to defend but is beaten.
Malinda Pushpakumara is in at no. 3. Nightwatch man.

OUT! JAFFA! Just how do you play those? Silva had no asnwers to that. England draw first blood through Leach. This is tossed up around middle, Silva lunges and plays the original trajectory. The ball turns away sharply, beating the outside edge and hitting the top of off. England are ecstatic. They still have a few overs to go today. They would love a couple more.
Floats it up on off, Silva drives it to covers.
Tossed up on middle, kept out.
Almost! This is tossed up on middle, it turns back in. Karunaratne tries to defend but the ball goes off the inner away from the leg slip fielder for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Karunaratne pushes it through covers for a run.
Flighted ball on off, the batsman keeps it out.

EDGED BUT DOES NOT CARRY! This is flatter and around off, it pitches and turns away. Karunaratne tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge but does not carry to first slip. Stokes there fails to stop it, it goes down towards the third man fence but is pulled back in. Two taken.
Flatter on off, it is kept out.
FLoats it up on middle, it is driven back to the bowler.
This is floated around off, Karunaratne strokes it through covers and the batsmen take two.
Moeen Ali is into the attack now.
On middle, Karunaratne works it towards mid-wicket. Batsmen rotate strike.
Flighted on middle, Dk drives it straight to mid on.
Fullish length on middle, Karunaranrte flicks it through mid-wicket.
Full on middle, Silva drives it through mid off for a single.
Flighted on middle, DK worked off his pads behind square. They get a run.
Tossed it up on middle, it hits the pad of the batsman. The bowler appeals but looks like its missing leg. Root was thinking of going for the review but did not go for it in the end.
Jack Leach is called to bowl.
Full delivery angling it. It hits the thigh pad but its going down leg.
Good length delivery around off, the batsman defends it of the back foot.
Play and miss. Good delivery from Jimmy. Length delivery around off, swings away and the batsman gets lucky as it did not get the outside edge.

FOUR! Streaky but effective. Fuller length swings a bit, Kaushal leans forward and tries to defend it but gets a thick outside edge and the ball goes in  between the third slip and gully to the boundary.
Length delivery on off, Kushal defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full delivery on middle, Silva leans forward and defends it off front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length on off, Karunaratne defends it onto the ground.
Down the leg side, the batsman tries to flick but misses.
Goes full again but no movement for the bowler. It comes in with the angle and Karunaratne works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Nicely timed! Full and on middle, Karunaratne plays it with a straight bat past the bowler and into the long on fence.
Around off, Karunaratne keeps it out off the front foot.
On the off pole, it is kept out by the batsman.
On off again, Silva gets right behind the line and defends it onto the ground.
On a length and around off, the batsman defends it out.
Around off, Karunaratne guides it through point for a single.
A little too wide outside off, left alone.
Another muted appeal! Down the leg side, Karunaratne tries to flick but the ball goes off the thigh pad to the keeper.

An appeal but not given! A delayed decision there by Karunaratne to play at it. It was on a length and around off, DK first thinks of leaving it but at the very end tries to block. He though is late to get his bat down. It goes into the mitts off the keeper. He appeals but the umpire shakes his head.
Similar delivery, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
In the channel outside off, Silva lets it be.
On middle and leg, Karunaratne tucks it to the leg side. The batsmen then rotate strike.
Good length delivery on off, the batsman leans forward and drives it to mid-on.
Good delivery from Sam, Full length swings away and beats the outside edge of the bat.
Length delivery on middle, Karunaratne works it to the leg side.
Sam Curran to bowl from the other end.
On middle, DK worked the ball off his pads. The batsmen rotate strike.
Fullish length on off, Silva leans forward and tries to defend it but the ball hits the inside half of the bat and it rolls towards fine leg. They get a single.
Full delivery on middle, the batsman has pushed it to the point region for a single. First runs for the Lankans.
Errs in line and length again. Full and wide down leg. Karunaratne goes for the flick but misses it. The keeper collects it nicely behind the stumps.
Identical delivery swinging away. Fokaes collects it brilliantly behind the stumps.
Starts off with a delivery wide down leg. The batsman does not need to play at those.
